consumer: The delivery quest/mission requirement check that asks 'is this mission's item requirement satisfied?' for the HUD readout.
scope: The mission's own item-requirement evaluation over whatever inventory reach and charge/count thresholds that objective defines, not just items on the avatar's person.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw wielded/worn/inventory items (a Class-S on-person enumeration), never invoking the engine's mission/objective satisfaction predicate.
divergence: The required item count is met only when charges across stacks aggregate to the threshold, or the item sits in a reachable container/vehicle the objective counts: carried_items reports the raw stacks while the mission predicate returns satisfied, so a frontend re-deriving satisfaction from carried_items disagrees with the engine.
